subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should `resetSessionEntryLifecycle` and its locked-harness owner handoff become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for externally observed session-boundary events?
rationale: The Teams bug and implementation are well supported, but tests cannot authorize a new third-party SDK and harness lifecycle contract; session and plugin owners must confirm that this is the intended long-term boundary rather than an internal or narrower capability.

options.title: Approve the narrow public contract
options.body: Confirm the documented reset semantics and owner handoff, refresh the branch against current main, and land the proven Teams fix.

options.title: Narrow the exposed seam
options.body: Keep the Teams behavior but replace the public method with a smaller owner-approved internal or capability-scoped API before merge.

options.title: Pause the lifecycle API
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers do not want plugins to initiate persisted session identity rotation because merging would create a difficult compatibility commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the documented reset semantics and owner handoff, refresh the branch against current main, and land the proven Teams fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the key lifecycle-scope correction on this branch and are the clearest current routing candidate for coordinating Teams, session, and Plugin SDK owner approval.
